verdict.rationale: Sandbox0's session supervisor is documented for background workers and agent runtimes that outlive an SDK call, which lets agent processes keep running in the background. Auto-resume lets inbound access wake a paused sandbox, and Sandbox Functions expose HTTP handlers without a long-lived server, so event-driven work can restart without manual intervention. However, there is no first-party way to define, schedule, or trigger automations; autonomous recurring runs depend on external orchestration such as GitHub Actions calling `s0`. missing for 10: native scheduling/cron or trigger-based automation definitions, documented end-to-end autonomous automation workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
